channel.title: Pocallum — News
channel.description: Cultural photography. Jazz, blues, theatre, dance and performing arts. Barcelona.

item.title: El Paral·lel oblidat
item.description: On September 6, a photography session in El Paral·lel as part of Festival MASiMAS 2026, in tribute to Merche Mar.

item.title: A day with the Barcelona Gipsy balKan Orchestra at the Palau
item.description: A full day with the Barcelona Gipsy balKan Orchestra: rehearsals, soundcheck and a memorable concert at the Palau de la Música Catalana, as part of the Mas i Mas Festival.

item.title: 24th Festival de Blues de Barcelona — three days in Nou Barris
item.description: From July 3 to 5, three nights of blues at the Nou Barris District headquarters and a closing jam session at the Roquetes Amphitheatre. Capibola Blues did it again.

item.title: Guide to Photography Exhibitions and Spaces in Barcelona
item.description: A curated list of the best venues in Barcelona and the metropolitan area where you can regularly see photography exhibitions, with direct links to their current programming.

item.title: La Juganera is now in our festivals section — and we were there last Friday
item.description: We covered the sixth edition of La Juganera at Nau Bostik. A neighbourhood festival that grows a little each year without losing what it is.

item.title: Jazz I Am 2026 — When a small festival has more to say than a big one
item.description: Full photographic coverage of the eighth edition of the showcase organised by Taller de Músics at El Molino, Barcelona.

item.title: We don't just take concert photos. We build a visual story for musicians
item.description: Visual support for artists and bands who want to communicate coherently and build an image with long-term impact.

item.title: Moving Still Images
item.description: Exploring the zoom burst technique to convey a sense of movement in static photographs.

item.title: Portraits to start the year looking sharp (and with a better portfolio)
item.description: Two portrait session options for artists who need to refresh their professional images.

item.title: Capturing Passion at the 'Ciutat Flamenco Barcelona' Festival — Olé!
item.description: Photographic coverage of Ciutat Flamenco Barcelona 2025, from Nau Bostik to the main stages.

item.title: Vanesa Aibar, with Estampa, at the Ciutat Flamenco Festival
item.description: Cristalización IV: contemporary dance, light beams and crystals in a piece that fuses flamenco with visual research.

item.title: The first challenge of 112 Revelats gets underway: 'Arrencant el dia'
item.description: 112 Revelats is an initiative by 112Books to give visibility to emerging photographers through collective work.

item.title: Vijazz 2025: The jazz that brought me back home
item.description: 18th edition of the jazz festival in Vilafranca del Penedès: established artists, unexpected discoveries and the double bass as a common thread.

item.title: A different perspective: analogue photography with personality and mystery
item.description: Sprocket Rocket and Adox HR-50 film at the Menorca salt flats: images that evoke salt, tramuntana wind and whites that almost hurt.

item.title: MABE with Kimono
item.description: Studio portrait session with Adox HR-50, Leica M4-2 and Summicron 50mm. Minimalist geisha aesthetic.
